name: Independent calibration labs (US)
description: Independent, owner-run US companies whose main business is calibrating measuring instruments for manufacturers in aerospace, medical devices, pharma, defense and automotive. Ideally 15+ years old, ISO/IEC 17025 accredited, offering on-site calibration, and not owned by private equity or a larger group.

criteria.question: Is instrument calibration the company's main business (not a side service of an equipment seller or manufacturer)?
criteria.label: calibration is the core business

criteria.question: Does the site say the company is ISO/IEC 17025 accredited?
criteria.label: ISO 17025 accredited

criteria.question: Does the company offer on-site (field) calibration?
criteria.label: offers on-site calibration

criteria.question: Does it serve regulated industries such as aerospace, medical devices, pharma or defense?
criteria.label: serves regulated industries

criteria.question: Does the text say the company is independent (family-owned, owner-operated, privately held) rather than part of a larger group or PE-backed?
criteria.label: independently owned
